name: tab-volume-normalizer
description: Firefox extension: per-tab audio volume normalization, toggled from a toolbar button.

scripts.build: web-ext build --source-dir . --artifacts-dir web-ext-artifacts --overwrite-dest --ignore-files package.json package-lock.json README.md LICENSE .gitignore scripts "scripts/**" ".github/**"
scripts.sign: web-ext sign --source-dir . --artifacts-dir web-ext-artifacts --channel=unlisted --ignore-files package.json package-lock.json README.md LICENSE .gitignore scripts "scripts/**" ".github/**"
